newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill unchanged on Enso, M-Serla.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill unchanged on Enso, M-Serla.

text.p: Merrill Lynch may upgrade its short-term view on Finnish forestry group Enso Oy to a "buy" and will reconsider Metsa-Serla when pressure on pulp prices eases, it said in a review dated January 13.
"We would consider changing our short-term recommendation (on Enso) to a Buy (from neutral) when the current pressure on pulp prices eases," Merrill said.
It forecast Enso's 1998 pre-tax earnings at 2.2 billion markka, up 78 percent on its estimate for this year.
"Enso is one of the most attractive stocks in the sector for more speculative investors," Merrill said. @
Enso's high exposure to pulp and fine paper would be negative in the short term, but would offer "high substantial leverage when the cycle turns", it said.
Merrill retained its "accumulate" recommendation on Metsa-Serla and forecast a 54 percent rise in 1998 pre-tax earnings to 770 million markka.
"This stock also has one of the lowest asset valuations in the sector. We will reconsider our rating when current price pressures on pulp prices ease," it said.
